description: Localises the uniform factor 6 in the convention-D atomic Markov prefactor (qou-cxon Q1) to the single inter-nucleon interface crossing. With include_inter off the D prefactor is exactly 2^(2A) for all six configurations (ratio 1/2 against the convention-C law 2^(2A+1)); switching the interface on multiplies by exactly 12 for every A>=2, independent of A, Z, N. A=1, which structurally has no interface, already sits at 1/2. The C law assigns that crossing a factor 2 (one averaged crossing), so 12/2 = 6 accounts for the whole discrepancy. 12 = 2^2 * 3 and the 3 is not a count: the bring_color_weighted interface carries delta(q) = (q-1)^2 (1 - q^-4) / 3, which a crossing count cannot see. This LOCALISES the 6; it does NOT derive it, and must not be cited as a derivation. Scope-(a) measurement of these six configurations only.

convention.markov_z: q**3/(q**2 + 1)   (convention D, canonical per the 2026-08-15 owner ruling R1)
convention.anchor: NONE enters the computation: tr_M_atomic is an integer-coefficient rational function of symbolic q, and every number here is the integer content of a denominator. The top-level q0Anchor/q0Value fields are the AMBIENT stamp applied by WitnessBuilder to every witness -- they record which pin this process ran under, not an input to any value below. Do not read them as an anchor for these prefactors.

assertions.name: inter_off_prefactor_is_two_pow_2A
assertions.note: the intra-nucleon half of the C crossing-count derivation transfers to convention D unchanged; only the '+1' does not

assertions.name: inter_off_ratio_to_c_law_is_one_half
assertions.note: uniform across A, Z and N

assertions.name: single_nucleon_already_at_one_half_with_inter_on
assertions.note: A=1 has no second nucleon, so no interface exists to switch off -- an independent check that does not rely on the include_inter flag

assertions.name: interface_factor_is_uniformly_twelve
assertions.note: independent of A, Z, N -- so it is one object, not a per-nucleon or per-strand contribution

assertions.name: uniform_six_equals_interface_twelve_over_c_two
assertions.note: 12 / 2 = 6: the C law gives this crossing a single halving; convention D with bring_color_weighted gives it 12
